title: Introducing deep research
summary: An agent that uses reasoning to synthesize large amounts of online information and complete multi-step research tasks for you. Available to Pro users today, Plus and Team next.
body: An agent that uses reasoning to synthesize large amounts of online information and complete multi-step research tasks for you. Available to Pro users today, Plus and Team next.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式推出“Deep Research”（深度研究）智能体。该代理利用先进的推理机制，能够自主合成海量在线信息，并为用户完成复杂的多步骤研究任务。目前已向Pro用户开放，并将陆续向Plus和Team用户推出。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI官方正式发布具备深度推理与网页综合能力的自主研究智能体，标志着AI代理在复杂多步骤任务上的重要技术升级与产品落地。
